vulnerablePath: supabase.auth.updateUser({ data: { is_admin: true } }) writes user_metadata
the claim is signed into the next access token
policy "notes: admin reads all" reads it and returns every row
expectedSecureBehavior: The admin claim comes from app_metadata (service role only) or a roles table, so a user who writes their own user_metadata gains nothing.
acceptableFixes: Join a roles table on auth.uid() inside the policy
Set the claim in a custom access token hook that reads a server-owned table
unacceptableFixes: Validating user_metadata in application code while the policy still trusts it
Dropping the admin policy and moving the same claim into a service-role query
